card.fires_on: The first piece of a word split into parts, usually a lone letter or short stub like "p", "reg" or "al" that begins a drug name or medical term. Common in label text such as pH, piroxicam, pantoprazole, albuterol and regurgitation.

card.writes: It favors word endings like "urger", "urga" and "ard", so it helps finish the split word that follows.
card.plain: It marks the first piece of a long word that the model has cut into parts, so the rest of the word can be completed.
